products.name: DeliveryMatch Shipping Platform
products.type: B2B SaaS - multi-carrier shipping and transport management
products.description: The core order and shipping platform: one cloud control layer between order systems, 200+ carriers and logistics partners for B2C and B2B, parcels and pallets, with rules, automatic carrier selection, labels, documents, tracking and dashboard.

primaryCustomers.name: Logistics Manager at a Manufacturer or Wholesaler

products.name: DeliveryMatch Dynamic Checkout
products.type: B2B SaaS add-on - checkout delivery options
products.description: Real-time, stock-aware delivery and pickup options with price, date and CO2 in the webshop checkout; presented as an advanced module.

products.name: DeliveryMatch Branded Track & Trace
products.description: Branded e-mail, SMS and WhatsApp notifications and tracking pages per sales channel, plus exception alerts and carrier performance insight.

products.name: DeliveryMatch Returns Management
products.description: Returns portal, reason codes, return methods and cost rules, labels and tracking; complemented by Returnista inside the Katapull group.

products.name: DeliveryMatch Carrier Invoice Control
products.description: Automatic comparison of booked and invoiced transport cost with discrepancy handling (also called the Freight Audit module).

primaryCustomers.name: Logistics Manager at a Manufacturer or Wholesaler

products.name: DeliveryMatch for Carriers and Brokers
products.type: B2B SaaS - transport management for carriers and brokers
products.description: Use of the platform by carriers and transport brokers: connect customers' systems, calculate rates and capacity per customer, manage subcontracted carriers and audit their invoices.

products.name: DeliveryMatch API and Integration Partner Programme
products.description: REST API, webhooks and partnership for software and system providers - including Katapull siblings - to embed 200+ carriers, rules, labels, tracking, returns and dynamic delivery options.

products.name: DeliveryMatch Shopify App
products.description: Shopify app (listed since August 2019, shown as free to install) that routes Shopify orders to carriers with shipping rules, checkout options, pickup points and a tracking dashboard; platform subscription applies separately (assumption).
